stories.title: Palmer Ridge Refuses Forfeit — Lutheran Controversy Escalates

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Palmer Ridge says it WILL play Lutheran High on Oct 30 — breaking with Coronado and Air Academy, who both forfeited. CHSAA investigation still open. NAACP and a state rep now weighing in. 🏈 #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: The Lutheran forfeit fallout continues. Both D11 and CHSAA have now issued statements denouncing racism. The ranking impact: forfeit games count as wins for Lutheran in state standings. Situation is still developing. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
